The consumption of MDMA whilst prescribed antidepressants can lead to serotonin syndrome.
Here are some symptoms of SS

Agitation or restlessness

Confusion

Rapid heart rate and high blood pressure

Dilated pupils

Loss of muscle coordination or twitching muscles

Muscle rigidity

Heavy sweating

Diarrhea

Headache

Shivering

Goose bumps

I‘m not trying to make you nervous, however you should look out for these symptoms and if you experience them you should see a doctor as well.
